longitudinal_hip_note: The long south roof has an approximately parallel ridge; west and east red roof sections extend farther north. A roof-level displacement of several metres is visible relative to the vector plan. The repeated outline and relative ridge directions, rather than individual absolute aerial pixels, inform these bounding rectangles.
pitch_status: Estimated slope of the photographed red roof. No roof section was available.

pediment.note: The two garden cameras constrain the outline well but their rays are almost parallel. Depth on the middle of the front slope and the short tile returns are conditional estimates; only one exposed pale triangular face is modelled.

west_bay.large_west_light: Eight narrow red lights and an upper transom above a solid apron, on a rectangular projection with two visible square supports.
west_bay.scope: The return behind the garden corner is shown through Y=8.2m, including the upper bay which extends about 5.7m along the side. The farther bow-front porch and separate address-188 street buildings are outside the documented section.

unobserved_outer_walls.basis: The 2021 and 2025 orthophotos show the red west and northeast roof returns. Their footprint relative to the registered west-facing windows carries several metres of roof-level parallax. Sanitary, adjoining and lane-front buildings are separate.
unobserved_outer_walls.west_front_y: The unornamented west block starts behind the measured 8.16m return. Trim its former projected southwest roof strip to Y=8.08 to preserve a normal eave in front of its supporting wall.
unobserved_outer_walls.geometry: Undocumented external wall units have a single muted continuous surface; the photographed courtyard face, west openings and canopy remain articulated. The horizontal roof soffit meets all measured or indicative upper walls.
